rules.rationale: ESOL: long SMILES lowered solubility (-11.46, weight 0.574); large nonpolar scaffolds partition into octanol.
Counter-hypothesis: the length role is low-confidence (0.22); very long chains often carry many polar, ionizable groups.
Source prior: short SMILES raised solubility (+6.89); small polar fragments stay hydrated and show low logD.
Extended aromatic pi surface is poorly hydrated, favoring the octanol phase and raising partition coefficients.

skills.hypothesis: Same size inversion as the incumbent but with an explicit very-long penalty and broad-coverage aromatic coverage, so the surrogate is informed early; fails if large target molecules are polar or ionizable.

rules.rationale: Ring role had the strongest transfer weight (0.758, effect 9.94); ring carbons add desolvated nonpolar surface.
Rotatable-bond role (weight 0.758): flexible branched chains expose polar groups and cost conformational entropy on transfer.
Donor-to-heteroatom role maps to hydrogen bonding; high heteroatom count lowers octanol-water partitioning.
Heteroatom-sparse scaffolds are nearly pure hydrocarbon, the classic high-logP end of the chemical space.

skills.hypothesis: Uses the two highest-transfer-weight roles (ring 0.758, branch 0.758) plus heteroatom polarity as the primary drivers, avoiding the low-confidence length role; fails if ring-rich scaffolds in this pool are heavily oxygenated.

state.lesson: Both prior skills scored within noise on development seeds (86.8 vs 86.5 mean AUC), a spread far smaller than the per-seed variance (79-94); the halogen_high rule rested on only 98 of 4200 molecules, so sparse-bin rules buy no reliable lift. The length inversion and broad-coverage aromatic surface carry the signal, and the uncertain very-long bin is better downweighted than left implicitly positive.
state.revision_summary: Kept the deployed length-inversion core because it was the higher-AUC skill and rests on broad bins, sharpened it with an explicit negative very-long rule instead of the sparse halogen rules, and paired it with a distinct second skill built on the two strongest transfer roles (ring 0.758, branch 0.758) plus heteroatom polarity, dropping halogens entirely since halogen_high covers only 98 candidates. Deployment frozen on lipophilic_surface_transfer for coverage and stability.
